launchPhaseDetail: Companion to the already-tracked RGBP (Revolut GBP). Revolut secured a MiCA CASP licence from Cyprus (CySEC) on Oct 23 2025 and operates an existing EMI licence in Lithuania — the legal foundations for issuing e-money tokens under MiCA Title IV. In February 2026, the FCA selected Revolut as one of 4 firms (from 20 applicants) for a UK stablecoin payment testing pilot covering payments, wholesale settlement, and crypto trading — results will inform the FCA's crypto framework targeting October 2027. Delta-neutral collateral and Apostro-attested reserves were no defense against an operator-level privilege failure.
